texts: good. everything is carried - the grinding, the scattering around a lit lantern, and the warding against wraiths - and the rule fires; it needs both the grinding and the scattering on record before it does, which is exactly what the sentence states.

good. the same content as your other phrasing and equally clean: both trigger clauses become plain conditions, "the feathers" and "the lantern" resolve back to them, and the shielding is tied to the scattering.
good. lands as a blanket denial covering every wraith and every warded lantern, which is the reading the sentence has.
good. parses as a fireable rule restricted to fresh ground feathers, with the restriction kept in the condition rather than asserted of feathers at large.
good. the negative twin of the previous sentence - a strength-0 rule restricted to stale ground feathers, with "stale" and "ground" both kept as conditions.
